sections.title: Your recorded requests
rows: Wade's terms for his rookie-scale extension: five additional seasons from 2007-08 (to 2011-12), the first year 20% below his fair market value on Miami's decision day (the front office's own market benchmark for his production within his minimum and maximum, set on 2006-10-31 from the closed 2005-06 season; the user's $12 million figure was an illustration only), the first four seasons fully guaranteed, the fifth a Miami team option, raises up to 10.5% of the first-year salary (cbafaq05 Q52), no no-trade clause. Legal as filed: one option season, the last (Q51), inside the five seasons a rookie-scale extension allows (Q52). Miami decides whether to offer by its own rule on 2006-10-31 (runtime/extensions.py) and adopts each term that is legal and at least as favourable to it as its rule; the offer then waits for the user's own accept or decline. If Miami does not offer, Wade plays out his rookie contract (2006-07 option exercised 2005-10-31).

Wade asks the front office to go after Trevor Ariza (Los Angeles Lakers, SF). On the date Ariza plays 2005-06 on the one-season $816,748 qualifying offer he accepted from the Lakers on 2005-09-30 (career/Dwyane_Wade/2004-05/10_Free_Agency/free_agency_2005.json); he was undrafted in the simulated 2004 draft, signed by Detroit on 2004-07-14 and traded to the Lakers on 2005-01-03. As a newly signed contract he cannot be traded before 2005-12-30 (three months after signing, or December 15 if later; cbafaq05 Q83). Miami's 2005-06 payroll ($67,315,693) is above the $61,700,000 luxury-tax line that is the owner's ceiling, so a trade may not raise it: Miami must send out at least his salary. The request weighs on Miami's in-season trade ranking by Wade's standing (runtime/trades.py); the Lakers decide their answer by engine draw; Miami may decline to pursue him. Not a star under the consultation rule.

Scouting recommendation: watch his perimeter defense, playmaking, competitiveness and development as a lead guard. On the date he is a Villanova sophomore; whether he enters the 2006 draft and where he ranks are decided by the simulation's draft-night evidence. Weighed only on Miami's own 2006 picks (runtime/draft.py); never a demand.

Scouting recommendation: watch his physical defense, rebounding, positional versatility and offensive development. On the date he is a Texas junior; whether he enters the 2006 draft and where he ranks are decided by the simulation's draft-night evidence. Weighed only on Miami's own 2006 picks (runtime/draft.py); never a demand.

The same request for the 2006 summer market, read by runtime/free_agency_2004.py for 2006 (this folder is the 2006 market's): if Ariza is still unsigned after 2005-06 (an unrestricted free agent, having played the season on his qualifying offer), Miami's front office moves him up its list by Wade's standing weight and may pay up to 110% of its valuation; it sets the terms, other clubs bid and Ariza answers by engine draw. Miami's 2006-07 commitments are $63,325,002 on the date, so without room the route is an exception (the mid-level of the 2006-07 rules once published). No term preference stated.

Camp opens with 20 players: 6 invitees on non-guaranteed minimums (Theo Ratliff, Bonzi Wells, Adonal Foyle, Jumaine Jones, Sam Cassell, Kwame Brown). Record: `camp_roster.json`.
Camp injury draws: nobody is hurt.

Cut to 15: Kwame Brown, Adonal Foyle, Theo Ratliff, Bonzi Wells, Sam Cassell. Promise check: every promised role is in the rotation. Record: `promise_log.json`.
